title: Jellyfish Impermanence
statement:
Jellyfish Impermanence presents a luminous jellyfish suspended in deep space. Subtle shifts in light and movement create a slow, meditative rhythm designed for continuous display.

The work explores transformation through fluid motion and evolving color. Forms expand, soften, and reconfigure without abrupt transitions, maintaining visual calm while remaining dynamically alive.
